title: Create Numismatics: Glass-Free Matching Vendors
description: Re-textures the Vendors from Create: Numismatics, removes the glass border and makes the Creative Vendor brass instead of purple.
body:
Re-textures the Vendors from Create: Numismatics by IThundxr, SlimeistDev, and spottytheturtle (found here https://modrinth.com/mod/numismatics)

If this resourcepack goes against the license of the original mod, let me know and I will fix any issue or take this down.

The pack removes the glass border and makes the Creative Vendor brass instead of purple.
This requires the mod linked above for obvious reasons.

This will only be updated if it breaks due to changes made in the mod.

This was made for a private server but anyone is free to use it if they like it!
